privacy.title: Amategeko namabwiriza
privacy.intro: Ikizamini cyo Gutwara ni serivisi yo kwitorezaho ikizamini cyo gutwara mu Rwanda. Aya mategeko namabwiriza agaragaza amakuru dukoresha, impamvu dukora, n'uburyo dukoramo. Ukoresheje porogaramu , usabwa kubahiriza ibiri muri yo.

sections.title: 1. Amakuru dusangira
body: Amakuru ya'konti: amazina yawe yose, adiresi ya email, ijambo banga ryawe (bikoreshwa mu buryo buboneye), umwanya wawe, n'ibyo ukunda kutangazwa nayo.

Amakuru y'ubwishyu: nomero ya telefone wishyuriyeho, amazina y'uwishyuye, nomero yihariye ya messaje wabonye umaze kwishyura, ubutumwa wahawe umazae kwishyura, n'ifoto ya messaje wabonye kugira ngo tugenzure.
Amakuru yo'kwiga: ibizamini byawe, ibisubizo, amamaza, streak z'ibizamini, ibyo wakoze, amakosa, amakuru y'ifatabuguzi, n'ibyitonderwa byawe ku bibazo.
Amakuru tekiniki: adiresi ya IP, amakuru y'ibizamini byose winjiyemo, n'ibiterekwa mu rwego rwo kuriye serivisi nkimikorere yimbere ya system.
Imibare y'uko porogaramu ikorwa: imibare y'amakuru ivuye kuri Vercel Web Analytics. Nta makuru yawe atangwa.

sections.title: 2. Dukoresha amakuru yawe gutya
body: Gukoresha serivisi: kubaka ibizamini byawe, kubikugezaho no kugaragaza aho ugeze, intege nke zawe.
Gukenzura ubwishyu: abayobora system bagenzura ubwishyu nibihamya watanze tugakora ifatabuguzi ryawe. Biciye mu buryo budashobora guhindurwa cyangwa ngo amakuru yawe abe yasibwa .
Gukura serivisi: kubuza aba hacker, kubuza ko winjiye cyane, no kubika ibiterekwa by'araporo (audit logs).
Kuvugana nawe: ubutumwa bwa email nk'oguhindura ijambo banga n'amakuru y'umutekano, n'itangazo mu porogaramu.

sections.title: 3. Ifoto z'ubwishyu na Mobile Money
body: Ifoto zibikwa mu buryo zitafungurwa na buri buri wese, kandi ababifiye ububasha bwo kugenzura ubwishyu gusa nibo bashobora kuzireba.

Reba ko nomero y'umwishyuri, amacumi n'irema rya transaction uhuzwa n'ikonti yerekewe kuri checkout. Ntidusaba Umubare wibanga (PIN) wawe, kandi ubwishyu bwemezwa unyuze kuri porogaramu — Ntahandi amakuru atanwgwa

sections.title: 4. Amakuru yibyo ukunda gukoresha n'ububiko bw'ikarita
body: Dukoresheje Amakuru yibyo ukunda gukoresha  n'ububiko bw'ikarita kugira ngo turinde amakuru ya konti yawe no kurinda fomu zitizewe
Vercel Web Analytics ntikoresha Amakuru yibyo ukunda gukoresha kandi nta naho itanga amakuru yawe.

sections.title: 5. Itangwa Ryamakuru
body: Abakoresha ubwishyu ba porogaramu n'abafasha abakora.
Abatanga serivisi ya hosting, database n'email; bakora amakuru gusa nk'uko byatanzwe.
Ntitugurisha cyangwa tugurana amakuru yawe yihariye kuri wese.

sections.title: 6. Igihe tubikamo amakuru
body: Igihe konti yawe irimo gukoreshwa, nyuma gusa yi igihe kisabwa (ubwishyu, ibyakozwe).
Ushobora kusaba ko konti yawe ifashwa, tukagufasha kwita kuri konti yawe yo muri iyi system.

sections.title: 7. Umutekano
body: Ijambo banga ribikwa mu buryo buhishwe, amakuru akwirakwiza muburyo buhishwe kandi bwizewe (HTTPS), kandi abashobora kureba amakuru yihariye ni bo gusa babyemerewe.
Nta murandasi iri 100% umutekano. kora kuburyo amakuru yawe yigenzi aba akomeye cyane.

sections.title: 8. Uburenganzira bwawe
body: Ushobora kureba, kuvugurura cyangwa gufata amakuru yawe  muri konti yawe, ushobora no gusohora amakuru y'ibizamini byawe.
Ushobora no guhagarika gukoreshwa kw'amakuru runaka, cyangwa guhagarika konti yawe ukoresheje konti yawe. Twandikire, tugufashe aho bigoranye.

sections.title: 9. Guhindura aya mategeko namabwiriza
body: Tushobora kuvugurura aya mategeko namabwiriza. Itariki y'ivugururo irahinduka, kandi uko ukomeza gukoresha porogaramu uzajya umenya niba yahindutse.

sections.title: 10. Tumenyeshe ikibazo
body: Niba ufite ibibazo kuri aya mategeko namabwiriza cyangwa amakuru yawe, twandikire kuri newcreativecentury@gmail.com.

privacy.contact: Ifite ibibazo kuri aya amakuru? Ohereza newcreativecentury@gmail.com tukagisubiza.

terms.title: Amategeko yo Gukoresha
terms.intro: Aya mategeko akoze ku buryo akwemerera kwitoza kuzakora Ikizamini cyo Gutwara. Gukoresha iyi porogaramu, bigusaba kubanza kwemera aya mategeko. Niba utayemera, ntuyikoreshe.

sections.title: 1. Serivisi
body: Porogaramu itanga ibibazo by'igerageza byikizamini, ibizamini byo kugerageza, no kubona aho ugeze, hamwe ni fatabuguzi ryawe. ibibazo bikoreshwa bishobora kugira iminduka gusa zizewe zigendana nigihe.

sections.title: 2. Konti
body: Ukeneye konti kugira ngo ukoreshe porogaramu. Ukeneye gutanga amakuru y'ukuri kandi yuzuye, kandi ugomba kuyavugurura igihe cyose bihindutse.
Ufite uburenganzira bwo gukoresha konti yawe gusa. Ntugomba gusangira ijambo banga ryawe cyangwa kwemerera abandi gukoresha konti yawe.
Niba utekereza ko konti yawe yinjiriwe n'umuntu utabifitiye uburenganzira, twandikire vuba kuri newcreativecentury@gmail.com

sections.title: 3. Ubwishyu n'ukenzurwa
body: Ubwishyu ni butumwa: ohereza ubwishyu na Mobile Money ku nomero yerekanwe, wohereze ifoto y'ubwishyu. Abgenzura sisitemu bagenzura ubwishyu mu minsi y'igenzura.
Niba ubwishyu bwawe bwemejwe, ifatabuguzi ryawe rizatangira gukora. Niba ubwishyu bwawe butemejwe, tuzagusubiza amafaranga yawe.

sections.title: 4. Ibikorwa ntibyemewe
body: Ntugomba kugira:
Gukoresha porogaramu mu buryo butemewe n'amategeko cyangwa butabangamira abandi.
Gukoresha porogaramu mu buryo bwo guhindura, gusenya, cyangwa kwangiza sisitemu.
Gukoresha porogaramu mu buryo bwo kwiba amakuru y'abandi cyangwa kuyakoresha mu buryo butemewe.
Gukoresha porogaramu mu buryo bwo gukwirakwiza virusi, malware, cyangwa ibindi byangiza sisitemu.

sections.title: 5. Amakuru y'ibyigishwa
body: Ibibazo byacu n'ibizamini byateguwe hakoreshejwe ikizamini cy'amategeko y'itwara mu Rwanda.

sections.title: 6. Uburenganzira bwa porogaramu
body: Porogaramu, imiterere yayo, amazina n'ibibazo byayo ni ibyacu . uko witwara nibibazo uhura nabyo bizakoreshwa mukuvugurura iyi sisitemu.

sections.title: 7. Ibyo utagomba gukora
body: Ntugomba:
Gukora kopi, guhindura, cyangwa gukwirakwiza porogaramu cyangwa ibibazo byayo.
Gukoresha porogaramu mu buryo bwo kwiba amakuru y'abandi cyangwa kuyakoresha mu buryo butemewe.
Gukoresha porogaramu mu buryo bwo gukwirakwiza virusi, malware, cyangwa ibindi byangiza sisitemu.

sections.title: 8. Guhagarika konti
body: Dushobora guhagarika konti yawe igihe cyose niba utemeye aya mategeko, cyangwa niba dukeka ko konti yawe ikoreshwa mu buryo butemewe.

sections.title: 9. Ibyo duteganya
body: Porogaramu itangwa "nk'uko iri" nta mbwirizwa zitandukanye. Ntitwizeye ko porogaramu izakora neza cyangwa ko ibibazo byose bizaba byuzuye.

sections.title: 10. Ibyo duteganya
body: Ntitwizeye ko porogaramu izakora neza cyangwa ko ibibazo byose bizaba byuzuye.

sections.title: 11. Guhagarika no kwishyura
body: Dushobora guhagarika porogaramu igihe cyose, kandi ntitwizeye ko izakomeza gukora. Niba porogaramu ihagaritswe, tuzagusubiza amafaranga yawe y'ifatabuguzi ry'igihe cyose ndetse niritararangira.

sections.title: 12. Amategeko agenga
body: Aya mategeko agenga ukoresha porogaramu.

terms.contact: Ufite ibibazo kuri aya mategeko? Cyohereza kuri newcreativecentury@gmail.com.
